name: ECUMaster Lambda to CAN
note: Every lambda field arrives UNSET, which is the point: set a lambda sensor's interface to CAN and point its frame and start bit at the field, so the reading comes with that sensor's calibration, operating window and P-codes instead of as a bare number on the bus. Lambda sits in bytes 4-5, not at the front: bytes 0-1 are supply voltage, 2 is heater power and 3 is sensor temperature. Bytes 6-7 are a fault word — 0x01..0x20 the sensor pin shorts, 0x40 low supply, 0x80/0x100/0x200 heater faults, 0x1C00 calibration state, 0xE000 sensor type (0 LSU 4.2, 1 LSU 4.9, 2 LSU ADV). A second frame on 0x665 carries pump current, oxygen concentration and Ri. The device can also be switched to emulate a Haltech, MoTeC or Link controller, in which case load THAT template instead of this one. ECUMaster do not publish a transmit rate for this frame, so the template states none — it is a receive frame and the ECU ignores the period anyway; Valid For is what decides when a reading has gone stale.
